sections.shortTitle: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ministers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 2017
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT III OF 2017
ACT
III OF 2017
KHYBER
PAKHTUNKHWA MINISTERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT,
2017
An
Act further to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and
Privileges) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Extraordinary, 30th
January, 2017]
No. PA / Khyber Pakhtunkhwa / Bills
/ 2017 / 4600, dated
30-1-2017.---The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ministers (Salaries, Allowances
and Privileges) (Amendment) Bill, 2017 having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 24th January, 2017 and assented to by the
Governor of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 25th January, 2017 is hereby published as
an Act of the Provincial Legislature of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
WHEREAS it is expedient further to
amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges)
Act, 1975 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. IV of 1975), for the purposes hereinafter
appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short title and commencement.---(1)
This Act may be called the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Ministers (Salaries, Allowances
and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 2017.
(2) It
shall come into force at once, and shall be deemed to have taken effect from
1st July, 2016.

2. Amendment of section 3 of the Khyber
Pakhtunkhwa Act No.IV of 1975.---In the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Act No. IV of 1975), in section 3, for the words forty thousand rupees and
thirty-five thousand rupees , the words rupees two lacs and rupees one lac
and eighty thousand shall respectively be substituted.
